title: Bloomin' Dunes - Pool, Pickleball & Tiki Bar
description:

It’s a great place to gather your favorite people and make unforgettable memories.

 The space 
Welcome to your perfect Arizona getaway! This spacious 6-bedroom, 3-bathroom home comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests, making it ideal for families, group trips, or multi-family vacations.

Just a short drive from parks, golf courses, shopping, restaurants, and local attractions, this home is the perfect base for experiencing everything Chandler and the Phoenix area have to offer. Whether you're visiting for relaxation, adventure, or quality time with loved ones, this home is designed to make your stay memorable.

 Guest access 
Guests have access to the entire home and backyard, including:
• Pool
 • Pickleball court
 • Hot tub
 • Game room
 • Tiki bar
 • Outdoor lounge areas
The only space not accessible is the locked cleaners’ closet.

 Other things to note 
License No: 311544
AZ TPT No: 21647666

Check-in is at 4pm
Check-out is at 10am

- Up to 2 dogs are allowed for $125 per stay, no cats please. We kindly ask that your dog is crate trained and that you pick up after your dog.
- Stays of 28 days or more may incur an additional cleaning fee.
- No parties allowed—violations may result in immediate termination of the stay. We aim to maintain a respectful environment for our neighbors.
- An exterior camera is installed solely to monitor our cleaning team for quality and security purposes.
- Parking is available for 3 vehicles in the driveway and 3 in the garage. Please note that street parking is not allowed (unlimited).
- If you're interested in a long-term stay, please reach out to inquire about availability
- Guests must be 25 years or older to book this property. 

GUEST VERIFICATION:
To help ensure a smooth and secure stay for all guests, the primary guest listed on the reservation may be asked to complete a quick verification process within 48 hours of booking, depending on the platform used to book the reservation.

Prior to check-in, guests may also be asked to sign a Rental Agreement that includes agreeing to our rental terms and conditions and, on certain booking platforms, providing a valid government-issued ID and matching credit card before arrival.

Included with your booking is our damage waiver coverage, which helps protect against accidental, self-reported damage during your stay when reported prior to check-out.
